subject: Re: Encord Contract Update
text:
Thanks, Michelle. I was able to check it out today. 

Given we have up to 5 users paid for through July, I wanted some clarification as to why doubling the team size to 11 would lead to a doubling of the per-user cost in this proposal? I.e. 4x the price for 2x the users

I understand from our conversation with your team last summer that the focus is not on small clients so the base price has risen. However, we have been a very low-maintenance client, requiring no support resources on your end since our on-boarding, and we were told our ease of use was a reason for maintaining a lower per-user cost. One of the reasons we renewed then was the understanding that as we scaled, the cost per user would decrease—not increase so I am a bit surprised by this proposal. 

As a seed stage startup, we were hoping for a pricing structure that better aligns with our growth trajectory. We’d appreciate your help in adjusting the pricing to better reflect our growth and low support needs. Could you let us know if there’s flexibility on this?

Best,
Corey
